backend/main.mo: Defines core backend types and state maps for users, questions, tests, sessions, and suggestions, including authorization and blob‑storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping backend–frontend integrations to specific files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of autogenerated summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend file.
frontend/docs/navbar-file-list.md: Documentation listing the Header component file, its usage locations, features, and styling notes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including MathJax configuration, SEO metadata, and root mount for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app container handling routing, identity loading, view persistence, and admin access checks.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that displays a fallback UI with options to navigate home or reload.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Placeholder button component for exporting average results as a PDF, currently logging a stub action.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays and manages comments for a question, including posting, deleting, and listing comments with loading states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, disclaimer, and external link attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides the main site header with navigation, authentication controls, and mobile menu handling.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Shows the overall leaderboard with ranking badges, current-user highlighting, and loading handling.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Renders math content using MathJax and re-typesets on content or theme changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Placeholder button for exporting full per-test results as a PDF; currently disabled.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Placeholder button for exporting per-test scores only as a PDF; currently disabled.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog for initial user profile creation with form validation and save mutation.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Placeholder dialog showing a question ID with a future full implementation note.
Displays a searchable, filterable question list with selection and admin-only deletion support.
frontend/src/components/QuestionManageme: Manages subject selection and loads corresponding questions, showing a gallery or loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Placeholder button for exporting a result list to PDF; logs data and is currently disabled.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog allowing admins to set start and end times for a test with validation and scheduling submission.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Provides WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons with prefilled text and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Admin panel for viewing, scrolling through, and deleting user suggestions with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: User form for submitting feedback with character limits, validation, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/TestConfigList.t: Displays a grid of test configuration cards with status badges, metadata, and a start/view button based on test state.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Provides a placeholder user management card indicating future admin functionality.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Shows a full‑screen loading overlay when a specific view is being activated.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: Handles YouTube subscription gating, linking users to subscribe and verifying access via backend mutation.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing view activation state with start, finish, cancel logic and a safety timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Loads and syncs user roles between backend and local bootstrap storage, exposing current role and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state and helpers using AuthClient, including login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides react-query hooks and helpers for converting backend data types to local models, mainly for user profiles, comments, and test configs.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and component styling such as headers and overlays.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, story, and branding content, signaling view activation on mount.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Displays admin-only panels for suggestions and question management, showing access control and activation handling.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Loads user profile, role, and test configs, handling loading/error states and rendering the main dashboard UI.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Shows the public landing page with hero sections and login/start-test logic tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Placeholder results page showing a static message and completing view activation.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Placeholder test-taking interface displaying a static loading message and finishing view activation.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Frontend type definitions mirroring backend Motoko models for users, tests, questions, comments, and leaderboards.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Stub utilities for exporting questions to PDF, with unimplemented single/multi export and preview functions.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: Manages per‑principal persisted roles in localStorage for fast admin/user UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routes.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Handles saving and restoring the last viewed app screens using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project state metadata including features, pending requests, and basic project info.
